nodes.name: Constrained ML Decorrelation
nodes.description: Atoms measuring or enforcing statistical independence between classifier predictions and a protected or nuisance variable

nodes.name: compute_cvm_mass_decorrelation
nodes.description: Measure prediction-mass decorrelation via rolling-window Cramer-von Mises statistic.
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], protected_variable: NDArray[np.float64], n_neighbours: int, step: int) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: CvM mass decorrelation slides a rolling window over samples, leading to quadratic time in sample size N scaled by step size S, and linear space.

nodes.name: compute_ks_agreement
nodes.description: Compute the Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance between two weighted prediction distributions via ROC curve identity.
nodes.type_signature: (data_predictions: NDArray[np.float64], mc_predictions: NDArray[np.float64], weights_data: NDArray[np.float64], weights_mc: NDArray[np.float64]) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing weighted AUC or Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance is dominated by sorting the predictions in O(N log N) time and linear space.

nodes.name: roc_auc_truncated_weighted
nodes.description: Compute weighted area under ROC curve segmented by TPR thresholds.
nodes.type_signature: (labels: NDArray[np.float64], predictions: NDArray[np.float64], tpr_thresholds: tuple[float, ...], weights: tuple[float, ...]) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing weighted AUC or Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance is dominated by sorting the predictions in O(N log N) time and linear space.

nodes.name: noise_injection_decorrelation
nodes.description: Decorrelate predictions by mixing with uniform random noise.
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], noise_level: float, random_state: int | None) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Mixing predictions with uniform random noise takes linear time and space in the size of the prediction vector N.

nodes.name: flatness_penalty_gradient
nodes.description: Compute negative gradient of flatness-penalized boosting loss combining AdaBoost classification loss with binned CDF-mismatch penalty for decorrelation. Suitable as a callable objective for boosting libraries.
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], labels: NDArray[np.int64], protected_variable: NDArray[np.float64], n_bins: int, power: float, fl_coefficient: float, uniform_label: int) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Ranking or sorting array elements is dominated by the O(N log N) time complexity of the sorting algorithm, and takes linear space.
